### No Doubt
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-july-18-2008-11579328.html
Passage: 1 Kings 18:1-5
Points:
- Three years of drought served to expose the utter uselessness of false prophets.
- God used the prolonged delay to soften hardened hearts and prepare the nation for truth.
- Elijah waited through the hardship without complaint because of his faith in the Lord.
- The arrival of God's word brought hope, demonstrating that God unfailingly keeps His promises.

### 7 Suggestions for When God Is Silent
Author: Ron Edmondson
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/7-suggestions-for-when-god-is-silent-bible-study-minute-january-25-2019.html
Passage: 1 Kings 18:1
Points:
- Elijah endured over three years of apparent divine silence during a severe national crisis.
- Spiritual dry spells and periods of waiting do not mean that God is absent or inactive.
- Believers navigating seasons of silence must confront personal sin and cling to foundational truths.
- Times of quiet waiting require deeper trust and an expectant posture to receive God's deliverance.
